# Remote-expert orchestration

Pool profiles for the distributed swarm: how many local experts the backend sidecar starts and which mixing strategy the pool uses. The expert block types a pool member can wrap are the feedforward experts (``praxis.EXPERT_REGISTRY`` mirrors ``DENSE_REGISTRY``). Selected with ``--orchestration-type``; default is ``none``.

Registry: ``praxis.ORCHESTRATION_REGISTRY`` (6 entries)

## `frontend_only`

Value: `{'sidecar': False, 'init_experts': 0, 'mixing': 'vote'}`

## `none`

Value: `None`

## `swarm`

Value: `{'sidecar': False, 'init_experts': 4, 'mixing': 'vote'}`

## `swarm_mean`

Value: `{'sidecar': False, 'init_experts': 4, 'mixing': 'mean'}`

## `swarm_sidecar`

Value: `{'sidecar': True, 'init_experts': 4, 'mixing': 'vote'}`

## `swarm_wave`

Value: `{'sidecar': False, 'init_experts': 4, 'mixing': 'wave'}`
